transfers.lesson: Keep a terse re-entry route, current status, revision receipt, context pack, and open-question/followthrough surfaces so future turns do not reconstruct the project from scratch.
Make claim surface, non-claims, evidence debt, release posture, and fail-closed guardrails explicit; this prevents workbench progress from masquerading as readiness.
Defeaters, rollback paths, dependency, and severity tests matter when a later source, contributor withdrawal, or cultural restriction invalidates prior surface text.

A simple accumulation file plus scratchpad and already-searched log preserves tone, rejected candidates, and search history; DeathVocab should keep narrative texture and rejected-source memory, not just JSON records.

not_transferred: No substantive cryptographic, cosmological, or parable content enters DeathVocab.
No giant lint/tool surface is copied; rev0001 stays small enough to read.
